# bs-score

> Your AI auditor lies. bs-score catches it — every claim is quoted, every quote is verified, and the score comes from code, not prose. The LLM finds defects and quotes the evidence; the bs-score CLI verifies every quote against the artifact it names, then scores what survived. Higher = more bullshit.

Install (no clone): `uvx --from git+https://github.com/alexhawat/bs_score bs-score --help`

## Canonical

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/SKILL.md): the agent recipe — workflow, finding object, hard rules
- [findings.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/findings.schema.json): the findings contract, enforced in full
- [scoring.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/scoring.json): the pinned per-review-type weights

## Checklists (one per review type)

- [repo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/repo.md): README claims + deep code pass
- [pr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/pr.md): a diff and its callers (also `branch`)
- [review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/review.md): a PR review graded against the diff
- [skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/skill.md): SKILL.md + every script it names
- [agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/agent.md): agent/persona configs
- [prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/prompt.md): one or many prompts
- [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/checklists/docs.md): one document, claims only

## Examples

- [examples/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/examples/README.md): worked findings + byte-exact score receipts
- [hallucinated](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/examples/findings.hallucinated.json): a fabricated audit scores 0

## Full context

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexhawat/bs_score/main/llms-full.txt): everything above, flattened into one file
